name: Oleander Renwick
original_name: オレアンダー・レンウィック
source:
[i]"...Don't get in my sister's way."[/i]

[b]Race:[/b] Vampire
[b]Interest:[/b] Fantasizing
[b]Weapon:[/b] Magic

A aristos vampire, eternally listless and tends to take things at his own pace. However, his abilities are considered excellent even among vampires of his social standing, casting magic swift enough to pose a threat to the protagonists.

He is Lynaria's younger brother and cares deeply about his sister.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=oleander]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
